# everyDock v1.0.0 — Your Docks, kept in sync

The first 1.0 release brings bidirectional Dock organization, automatic native-Dock handoff, and Apache-2.0 licensing to Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later.

## What's new since v0.4.1

- **App order and pins sync both ways.** Changes in macOS Dock are read when everyDock starts, resumes, becomes active, and during its five-second active check. Reorders, pins, and unpins in everyDock also update macOS Dock. Upgrading imports the native pinned-app list, including additions and removals, so its order replaces the saved local app sequence. everyDock separators keep their identities and local slots; Finder retains its local slot and native fixed position. Native folders, Trash, spacers, and tile metadata are preserved.
- **Use macOS Dock without an external display.** This new option is on by default, including for existing installations without a saved choice. everyDock restores the native Dock and suspends its Dock UI, pointer timers, recurring app checks, previews, folder watching, and window adjustment. Reconnecting an external display resumes everyDock. Single external displays and mirrored external displays also keep it active. Battery savings have not been measured.
- **Press and hold to organize.** Hold an icon or separator for 0.30 seconds, then drag. Command is no longer required. Magnification collapses while moving; dropping an app into the running section unpins it.
- **Apache-2.0 license.** Commercial use, modification, and redistribution are permitted under the standard license. Copyright and ownership of any patents remain with their respective owners, while Section 3 grants its specified royalty-free patent permissions. LICENSE and NOTICE are included in the app bundle. This does not assert any patent filing or grant.

English/Korean selection, full-screen display off by default, the 0.60-second preview delay, clearer cached icons, and separate permission requests/settings links remain available from v0.4.1. Saved options are preserved, subject to the new native pin synchronization described above.

This release remains **ad-hoc signed and not notarized**. The release number does not imply Apple notarization or completion of the full device, permission, or performance matrix. See the [v1.0.0 QA record](https://github.com/hungryZoo/everyDock/blob/main/docs/QA-v1.0.0.md) for executed checks and remaining manual work.

## Install

Install Homebrew first, then run:

```bash
brew install --cask hungryZoo/tap/everydock
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/everyDock.app
open -a everyDock
```

## Update

Quit everyDock, then run:

```bash
brew update
brew upgrade --cask hungryZoo/tap/everydock
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/everyDock.app
open -a everyDock
```

Upgrade preserves settings; uninstall/reinstall resets them. For an exact v1.0.0 manual installation, download `everyDock-1.0.0-arm64.zip` and `SHA256SUMS` from this release. Verify both files in the same directory with `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` before extracting the app.
